# Wuttiphong Butta (วุฒิพงษ์ บุตตา)

> Thai name: วุฒิพงษ์ บุตตา, nickname โพสต์อิท (Post-it). Software engineer in Thailand building AI systems, internal platforms and web products. Open to work. Contact: wuttiphong4work@gmail.com

## Site
- [Portfolio](https://wuttiphongbutta.netlify.app/): Work, experience, activities, sport, about and contact (English and Thai)

- [Full text](https://wuttiphongbutta.netlify.app/llms-full.txt): Full portfolio content for LLMs

## Projects
- [QwenMythos](https://huggingface.co/Wuttiphong23/qwenmythos_Version_1.0): Self-trained 4.2B Recurrent-Depth open-weight LLM on a Thai reasoning dataset (OpenMythos), GGUF Q4_K_M, 262k context
- AI OCR: Document intelligence that reads Thai and English invoices end to end
- STQ Orbit: Correction and validation layer in front of QuickBooks with automatic receipts
- ORBIT Platform: Event-driven internal platform with a schema registry and typed SDK
- AI Chatbot (RAG): Retrieval-augmented assistant with citations on every answer
- SEO · GEO · AEO: Search, generative and answer engine visibility work

## Experience
- AI & Technology Specialist, Give Education and Aquatots Thailand (2026, full-time)
- [AI Engineer (Intern), Smarterware Co., Ltd.](https://www.smarterware.co.th/) (2026, Nonthaburi)

## Sport
- TaeKwonDo: rising prospect on track for the national team until a left-knee injury; runner-up at the 33rd National Youth Games (Chumporn-Ranong) and the 35th Kanchanaburi Games; 4th place, Thailand Championship (Cadet)
- Represented Bangkok University at University games Thammasat; Lopburi province basketball representative
- Assistant coach with teams from Singapore, China and Taiwan; best athlete / MVP honours
